actual_usd: number|null; null means unknown, unverified, or unavailable — never a zero cost; numeric 0 means a verified actual cost of zero only; never invented
authorized_live_count: integer; live attempts authorized for the campaign
cost_verified: 'verified' means checked against a billing source; 'unverified' means a cost figure exists but is unchecked; 'unavailable' means no cost figure exists (use with actual_usd null)
error_details: string; controlled error text only, no credentials or payloads
estimated_usd: number|null; null when unknown; never invented
image_id: string; image identifier only, never bytes
notes: string; reviewer notes, no personal data
response_summary: string; counts/shape only, never raw payloads
utc_timestamp: string; ISO-8601 UTC, null when not executed

notes: NON-EXECUTED EXAMPLE: illustrates the record shape only. Not an actual test run. No live request was made; no cost exists.
